name: vox-style
description: Turn a topic, a trend, an article or nothing at all into a finished narrated motion-graphics explainer video. Researches, writes the script and storyboard, shows everything at one approval gate with a credit estimate, then generates the style key, voiceover, clips and one assembled MP4. Six modes, three locked house styles, and a manual Google Flow path that spends no Higgsfield credits.
